is_credential_weak.description: If the the credential is labelled as weak in the user's vault.

is_credential_compromised.description: If the the credential is labelled as compromised in the user's vault.

is_credential_reused.description: If the the credential is labelled as reused in the user's vault.

is_credential_excluded.description: If the credential excluded from the security score calculation.

is_credential_deleted.description: If the credential has been deleted.

credential_security_status.description: Security attributes of a credential in the user's vault.

is_leaked.description: Whether the password has been found on the Dark Web. This is strictly tied to the password value, and unlike the compromised password definition, it has neither link with the email nor with the Dark Web Monitoring feature.

is_direct_import.description: If the user selected the 'Direct Import from LastPass' option in the first step of the Import Data flow

item_id.description: unique identifier, default to {00000000-0000-0000-A000-000000000000}. It is generated by server when the item is added to a vault for the first time, but changes (new item_id generated) when an item is unshared (revoked access). When an item is shared, the receiver will have the same item_id as the sender.

action.description: The action that happened on or with the vault item

data_source.description: The type of data that was downloaded, transferred or submitted by user or admin

characters_typed_count.description: The number of characters typed in the search bar before interacting with an item or quitting the search UI

highlight.description: The kind of highlight for the vault item in a list

item_type_with_link.description: Type of vault item that can open an external link

field.description: Different vault item properties, visible or not on the details view. Boolean values have two states _on/_off

has_interacted.description: Whether the user has interacted with an item (search followed by a click, copy, open vault dropdown on an item) in the search UI or not

index.description: index of the selected item in the list (the first item is 1)

item_source.description: The source of the item in the vault: manual if added by the user themselves, or shared if it came from direct or collection sharing

total_count.description: total count of items in the list

dropdown_type.description: Type of the dropdown menu on a vault item, mainly on the web as of 06/2021

otp_addition_error.description: The error type during the failure of the OTP code addition to a credential. <ul> non_otp_qr_code (invalid QR code, e.g. scanned a restaurant menu QR code for example) <ul> non_otp_text_code (when wrong activation key is entered, e.g. entered "abcd" into manual set up code for example) <ul> no_secret (when the secret is missing from the OTP data. Potential malformed secrets fall into unknown_error) <ul> missing_login (when no issuer is available on QR code, e.g. missing "linkedin.com" from the domain of the QR code and cannot match. Only occurs when no item_id, i.e. we're not setting up from a specific item.) <ul> multiple_credentials (when multiple credentials are matching the issuing domain and we cannot distinguish based on user on the QR code)

otp_addition_mode.description: The selected mode to add an OTP (one-time-password) code to a credential

otp_code_size.description: The number of digits in the generated OTP (one-time-password) code

otp_type.description: The type of one-time-password (HMAC-based one-time password or time-based one-time password)

otp_increment_count.description: The incrementing counter of the OTP (one-time-password). This applies only to HOTP.

duration_otp_validity.description: The duration of the validity of the OTP (one-time-password) code, in seconds. This applies only to TOTP.

encryption_algorithm.description: Type of encryption algorithm. 'other' should be sent when there is an algorithm available but it does not fall in the algorithms we listed. If there is no algorithm, no value should be sent.

authenticator_issuer_id.description: Only use in anonymous events - SHA-256 hash of the issuer of the OTP code added by the user within the authenticator feature or the authenticator app. In most of the case, the pre-hash issuer name should be a lower-case domain name (without top level domain). Note that when added to a credential, the issuer name does not necessarily corresponds to the credential website because users could still add any functioning OTP to any credential, it will just not work with the specified credential website. eg: google => bbdefa2950f49882f295b1285d4fa9dec45fc4144bfb07ee6acc68762d12c2e3

multi_select_id.description: Identifier of a multi-select update. Null if the update is manual. This ID is unique for those multi-selected credentials and they are not shared between different users. In its vault, the user can multi-select items (credentials, secure notes...).

backup_file_type.description: The type of backup or method used when importing/exporting data. Unknown is when the file does not match the expected import formats.

transfer_data_status.description: Whether the import/export of vault data succeeded or failed

import_data_drop_action.description: Additional information about the reason that triggered the termination of the import data flow

transfer_data_step.description: The step at which the import data process has finished (whether successfully or not)

transfer_data_source.description: The source or destination of the data being transferred. This can be a password manager from which the data was exported or other.

transferred_items_count.description: Count of items successfully transferred to or from Dashlane

items_to_transfer_count.description: Count of items in the file transferred by the user

has_clicked_collection.description: Whether the user clicked a collection in the search results

search_collection_count.description: Count of collections returned by the search

filter_collection_count.description: Count of collections selected in the filter

is_from_search.description: Whether the filter originated from the user clicking a collection in the search results

collection_id.description: Unique identifier for a collection, default to {00000000-0000-0000-A000-000000000000}

collection_action.description: The action that happened on the collection

item_count.description: Count of items in the vault affected by the action

collection_count.description: Count of collections associated with item

collection_select_origin.description: Where the user selected the collection from
